name: context-meter
description: The context window fill at the bottom right of the prompt, with a detail card on hover and /context-meter.

warnAt.title: Warning from
warnAt.description: Context percentage from which the meter uses the warning color.

dangerAt.title: Danger from
dangerAt.description: Context percentage from which the meter uses the error color.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the card and the /context-meter output: en (English) or es (Spanish).
